entities.name: Fetal growth restriction
observations: Estimated fetal weight below the 10th percentile at 34 weeks meets the SMFM definition of FGR even with normal anatomy and amniotic fluid.
Umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry is the key next evaluation for placental resistance and risk stratification.

entities.name: Constitutionally small fetus
observations: Short parental stature supports constitutional smallness, but does not establish it without reassuring Doppler, interval growth, and fetal surveillance.

entities.name: Umbilical artery Doppler next
observations: For a fetus below the 10th percentile at 34 weeks, obtain umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry before relying on routine growth or fetal testing alone.

entities.name: Later surveillance
observations: Repeat growth ultrasound is generally spaced about 3–4 weeks for reliable interval growth; weekly NST/CTG is appropriate when FGR is stable and UA Doppler is reassuring.
